Enable Auto-generate ATF tests to allow ServiceNow to use ATF Test Generator tool to intelligently generate regression tests for your upgrade process. Automated Test Framework test suites that have been auto-generated are added to the Upgrade Test Suites table. The tests in the Upgrade test suites table run automatically post-upgrade.

The created tests are added to the Upgrade test suites table to consolidate all testing items.
